title: A Semester for the Yearbook
author: Felix Coldharbour
blurb: Dominic Amberdale, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
